parsed_json.up: Select activity details for ALOGLIPTIN (CHEMBL376359) and all its salts. Identify the parent compound and all related salts using molecule_hierarchy parent mapping from CHEMBL376359. Filter the compound set by molecule_dictionary.chembl_id for the parent and salts. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno. Join compound_records.record_id to activities.record_id. Join docs through compound_records.doc_id. Do not use activities.molregno as the activity join key and do not use assays.doc_id for the publication join. Filter activities for IC50 bioactivity values in nM against target CHEMBL284 (Dipeptidyl peptidase 4). Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not limit the number of rows.
